name: Jared Polis
stance: Signed and then narrowed Colorado's algorithmic-discrimination AI law, and supports federal preemption of state AI laws for several years in favor of a national framework.

statements.text: Through a spokeswoman, backed a federal moratorium preempting state AI laws for several years so Congress can create a 50-state solution, while preferring a period shorter than ten years.
Signed SB 25B-004 in a special session, delaying the Colorado AI Act's effective date from February 1 to June 30, 2026.
Signed SB 26-189, replacing the 2024 Colorado AI Act with a narrower notice-and-disclosure law for automated decision-making, effective January 1, 2027.
